title: UK album release: Time Takes Time by Ringo Starr | 1992
content:
Ringo Starr’s tenth solo studio album, Time Takes Time, was released in the United Kingdom on 29 June 1992.

The lead single, ‘Weight Of The World’, was released in the UK on 18 May. Starr’s cover of ‘Don’t Be Cruel’ was a b-side of the single, and was included on the Japanese edition of the album.

Despite high hopes for Time Takes Time, it failed to chart in the US and UK. It was released only on vinyl in Brazil, Germany, Mexico, and Spain.

A second single, ‘Don’t Go Where The Road Don’t Go’, had been planned, but was only issued in Germany on 21 September, with ‘Don’t Know A Thing About Love’ and the album outtake ‘Everybody Wins’ as b-sides.

Page last updated: 27 August 2021
